items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1964-03-21
items.q: and I'd be still working with Thomas about three nights a week

ctx.x: Well, I played that for a while. Then later on, that, uh, fellas began falling out. Nice we had supposed to have had instructions. Fellas began having dates, you know. Couldn't come out to rehearsal, uh, instructions. So, therefore, that, uh, caused the band to disband, see. And, uh, from that, well, the fellas went astray. And, uh, I wonder if you can hear me. Yeah. Mm-hmm. So, therefore, that's, uh, that's where I started music, and from the church, on the violin. What instrument did you take? And you must have…
All right, we're rolling. What's your name?

items.title: Manuel Paul Interview, 1960-04-19
items.q: He got out with Thomas. And they couldn't see that car coming. So when the fellas seemed as if they had saw us.

ctx.x: You were talking about that wreck that they had. Thomas started to tell me about it. We never got it on tape.
Never got it on tape. Well what happened that Sam was on the outside of the car. He got out with Thomas. And they couldn't see that car coming. So when the fellas seemed as if they had saw us.
We were going to go over some of these photographs of Manuel's.
